sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate preserves the required ship targeting, formula operands and direction, expected-result-scaled tolerance, and exact inclusive 740 kW minimum for IB/IC. Its complementary SPARQL branch correctly prevents IB/IC cases from bypassing the floor, and the piecewise absolute-value calculation uses permitted direct operations.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the 740 kW regulatory floor so it is represented as an exact inclusive minimum (sh:minInclusive 740, or an equivalent bounded branch explicitly enforcing inclusive equality semantics) rather than only a SPARQL violation test using ?actual < 740. Preserve the formula comparison direction and its expected-result-scaled tolerance.

Preserve the prior repair: retain the exact inclusive 740 kW minimum and the expected-result-scaled formula tolerance. The sh:or currently has an unconditional third branch requiring only iceClass, so an IB or IC ship with power below 740 kW can satisfy that branch and bypass the regulatory floor. Replace it with an explicitly non-IB/non-IC branch (or otherwise make the IB and IC alternatives exhaustive and mutually exclusive), while preserving the formula comparison and ship-owner targeting.

Preserve the prior repairs: retain the exact inclusive 740 kW minimum and the expected-result-scaled formula tolerance. The third sh:or branch is still logically inverted: its SPARQL constraint returns a violation for non-IB/non-IC classes, while it conforms for IB/IC, allowing an IB or IC ship below 740 kW to bypass both floor branches. Replace it with a branch that conforms only when iceClass is neither nltl:iceClassIb nor nltl:iceClassIc, for example by making the violation query select IB/IC cases, so IB/IC must satisfy the explicit sh:minInclusive 740 branch. Also replace unsupported ABS(?expected) with permitted direct-calculation operations, such as a bounded piecewise absolute-value equivalent, while retaining tolerance scaling from the expected formula result rather than the reported value.

Candidate preserves the required ship targeting, formula operands and direction, expected-result-scaled tolerance, and exact inclusive 740 kW minimum for IB/IC. Its complementary SPARQL branch correctly prevents IB/IC cases from bypassing the floor, and the piecewise absolute-value calculation uses permitted direct operations.
